summary: Alerus Financial Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose the sale of three nonperforming loans with a total net book balance of $33.6 million as of March 31, 2026. The loans represented 62.3% of total nonperforming loans and 62.1% of nonperforming assets. The transaction was completed with no charge-offs and $1.6 million in nonaccrual interest recorded. This is a routine asset-quality action, not a special situation; the filing simply reports the loan sale and its impact on nonperforming asset ratios. No deal terms or strategic event warrant classification.
